DeepSeek-V3 is incredibly powerful, but serving a 671B parameter model requires serious hardware. 
Instead of paying massive cloud egress fees and inflated hourly rates, deploy it on Multi-GPU Bare Metal. Our latest blueprint covers #vLLM configuration, Tensor Parallelism (--tensor-parallel-size 8), NCCL optimization, and #DockerCompose setups for 8x GPU nodes.

Read the full technical guide
https://www.eservers.uk/tutorials/howto/scaling-deepseek-v3-multi-gpu-nodes/
